    j = borough_to_idx[row['neighbor']]

# Calculate Moran's I

# Permutation test for significance
n_perm = 500
count = 0
for _ in range(n_perm):
    np.random.shuffle(changes_std)
    I_perm = (n / S0) * (changes_std @ W @ changes_std) / (changes_std @ changes_std)
    if I_perm >= I:
        count += 1
